title: Local and Global Master Equations through the Lens of Non-Hermitian Physics
summary: We investigate the relation between non-Hermitian Hamiltonian and Lindblad dynamics in nonequilibrium open quantum systems. Non-Hermitian models can extend phase diagrams and enable sensing advantages, but such effects often rely on postselection, raising questions about their relevance for unconditional dynamics. Using a minimal two-qubit setup mediating a heat current, we compare local and global Markovian master equations with their non-Hermitian counterparts.
